11/12 Activists return to NYT HQ to stand in solidarity with Palestine and the well-known children’s educator and human rights advocate, Ms. Rachel, who the NYT is plotting to smear for her anti-genocide activism! 🇵🇸 

Less than a week ago @msrachelforlittles put out a statement saying that she is unsubscribing from the New York Times. She cites the NYT’s dehumanization of Palestinians and lack of journalistic integrity in its coverage of the ongoing genocide in Palestine. As she pointed out the NYT has instructed its employees to avoid words including: Slaughter, Genocide, Ethnic cleansing, Occupied territory, and Palestine. (The Intercept) 

These terms have legal definitions which countless human rights organizations and genocide scholars have concluded are appropriate and the correct description of israel’s actions in occupied Palestine.

Ms. Rachel also shared that in an interview with the NYT the “news outlet” falsely accused her of spreading minformation, receiving money from Hamas, and speaking about a subject “that doesn’t seem to implicate directly what she is best known for”. 

Ms Rachel has inspired hundreds- if not thousands of her followers to unsubscribe from the New York Times. 

🍉We applaud Ms. Rachel’s bravery and encourage everyone to follow her lead and #UnsubscribefromtheNYT 

#Solidarity #MediaAccountability #FreePalestine
